changes.change: Source-backed citation answers, viewers and audits render canonical source content, verify current source bytes, and discard provider excerpts and metadata.
Executive key figures remain source-derived; the synthesis cache contract is invalidated.
Shared numeric parsing preserves Unicode signs, accounting negatives, suffix currencies, scales and scientific notation; ambiguous grouping, compound units and unbounded exponents are rejected.
File-backed authority policy keys no longer collapse distinct tenants. Corrupt or ambiguous legacy saved policies fail closed, with HTTP 503 on query routes.
128 HTTP negative cases exercise both query endpoints, four roles, two persona-selection locations and eight restricted/mixed-domain questions; source/answer loaders must not run.
Claim-backed QA applies the numerical validator to provider-supplied citation excerpts as well as answer, basis and suggestions.
A configured authority database outage or missing driver cannot switch either policy reads or writes to local-file permissions.

Expanded real database ownership tests cover two tenants with overlapping BU names across run, snapshot, checkpoint, artifact, decisions, citation search, QA context and list access. Local latest/current pointer tests cover all sixteen owner/pointer combinations.

local_validation.note: Runs overlap; counts must not be added as distinct tests.

unclosed_acceptance.G05: QA prose still uses numeric value/unit membership, not semantic metric/period/subject binding. Claim-backed QA intentionally has no raw evidence bundle; its citation verification needs an authorized immutable claim-reference contract distinct from file-backed citation resolution. Causal validation also remains open.
unclosed_acceptance.G06: Source policies bind user roles, tenant and BU, but do not carry an explicit assistant-domain entitlement. Keyword refusal coverage is not equivalent to source-level user/assistant/tool authority intersection.
unclosed_acceptance.G07: Expanded two-tenant/two-BU ownership and latest/current pointer proofs now pass, including overlapping BU names, citation search, artifact lookup and QA context guards. They do not yet form a complete product-wide matrix for semantic retrieval, every export and all legacy surfaces.
unclosed_acceptance.G10: Latest independent assessment remains 24/50: 14 insufficient-evidence, 10 partial and 2 calculation-gap cases. No new full 50-question release result is claimed.
